boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Academy places that support studying, student services, and hands-on maritime learning.

cards.title: Nutting Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Platz Hall · study and research space
cards.notes: Use the three-level library to choose a work setting, locate course material, or ask staff for research help before settling into a session.
cards.short_summary: The Academy library combines collections, research support, and several kinds of study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Nutting Memorial Library is in Platz Hall and provides work and study spaces for the Academy community.
cards.source_title: The Campus | Maine Maritime Academy Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Library hours and access vary by term; consult the library page before visiting.

cards.title: The Chart Room
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · quiet conversation area
cards.notes: Bring a small discussion or shared reading here when you need to talk quietly; the rest of the upper level is designated for silent study.
cards.short_summary: A named library area where quiet conversation is permitted.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chart Room is available for quiet conversation, while most of Nutting Memorial Library's upper level is a silent-study floor.
cards.source_title: Policies & General Information | Nutting Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Located within Nutting Memorial Library; follow library study policies.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · student ID access
cards.notes: Use the tables, soft seating, microwave, or reservable four-seat pod when the main library is closed; bring your MMA ID for entry.
cards.short_summary: A year-round student lounge for studying outside regular library hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Nutting Memorial Library's 24-Hour Study Lounge is available to students year-round and includes tables, soft seating, a reservable study pod, microwave, and vending machine.
cards.source_title: Policies & General Information | Nutting Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Available to students 24 hours a day year-round; Academy ID is required when the library is otherwise closed.

cards.title: The B-100 Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Platz Hall lower level · 20 seats
cards.notes: Plan computer-based work here when it is not reserved for a class, and use the black-and-white printer for academic tasks as needed.
cards.short_summary: A 20-seat lower-level computer lab with student ID access.
cards.evidence_claim: The B-100 computer lab in Platz Hall seats 20, has a black-and-white printer, and is available for student use 24 hours a day when not reserved for class.
cards.source_title: Policies & General Information | Nutting Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Student use is 24 hours with Academy ID when the lab is not reserved through the Registrar's office.

cards.title: Harold Alfond Student Center
cards.subtitle: Main campus · dining, meetings, and student services
cards.notes: Coordinate a meal or meeting around the building’s dining spaces, conference rooms, post office, lecture hall, and SGA office.
cards.short_summary: A single campus stop for dining, meeting rooms, mail, and student government.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harold Alfond Student Center houses dining facilities, conference rooms, classrooms, the Waypoint Snack Bar, campus post office, multi-media lecture hall, and Student Government Association office.
cards.source_title: The Campus | Maine Maritime Academy Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Services and room availability may vary; check with the relevant campus office before planning a visit.

cards.title: Training Ship State of Maine
cards.subtitle: Waterfront campus · Marine Transportation flagship
cards.notes: See the Academy’s current training ship from approved waterfront areas, and look for official announcements before expecting public access or tours.
cards.short_summary: The Academy's National Security Multi-Mission Vessel serves as the Marine Transportation flagship.
cards.evidence_claim: The 500-foot Training Ship State of Maine is the flagship of Maine Maritime Academy's Marine Transportation program.
cards.access_notes: A working training vessel; access aboard is not stated as public and should be treated as authorization-dependent.

cards.title: Schooner Bowdoin
cards.subtitle: Waterfront campus · National Historic Landmark
cards.notes: View this named schooner from authorized waterfront space and use Academy waterfront updates to learn when its student voyages or events are scheduled.
cards.short_summary: Maine's official vessel is part of the Academy waterfront fleet.
cards.evidence_claim: The schooner Bowdoin is a National Historic Landmark and the Official Vessel of the State of Maine; Academy students have sailed it on voyages to Labrador and Greenland.
cards.access_notes: Treat the schooner as an operational Academy vessel; boarding or tour access is not stated as public.

cards.title: Tug Pentagoet
cards.subtitle: Waterfront campus · tug-and-barge training vessel
cards.notes: Find the tug on the waterfront during Academy activities, and ask the Waterfront department about any authorized opportunities to see its training role.
cards.short_summary: A named tug central to the Academy's on-campus tug-and-barge program.
cards.evidence_claim: The tug Pentagoet is the central vessel used in Maine Maritime Academy's on-campus tug-and-barge program.
cards.access_notes: This is an operational training vessel; no public boarding access is stated.

cards.title: Capt. Susan J. Clark
cards.subtitle: Waterfront campus · navigation training vessel
cards.notes: Use the vessel’s name and visible equipment as a prompt for maritime-navigation study, while respecting Waterfront staff directions and vessel boundaries.
cards.short_summary: A 70-foot vessel fitted for student navigation training.
cards.evidence_claim: Capt. Susan J. Clark is a 70-foot twin-screw crew-boat-style vessel that serves as the primary navigation training vessel for the Thompson School of Marine Transportation.
cards.access_notes: Operational training-vessel access is not stated as public; follow Waterfront department guidance.

cards.title: Research Vessel Friendship
cards.subtitle: Waterfront campus · marine science research vessel
cards.notes: Spot this named research vessel from authorized areas and connect its instruments to the marine-science programs they support on campus.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront research vessel equipped for Academy marine-science work.
cards.evidence_claim: Research vessel Friendship serves Marine Science programs and is equipped with side-scan sonar, a remotely operated vehicle, and oceanographic instrumentation.
cards.access_notes: Operational research-vessel access is not stated as public; view only from permitted waterfront areas unless authorized.
